hook: 三個按鈕：abolish 廢法、abominate 厭惡、demolish 拆樓——按錯會變成「我很討厭這棟合法建築並拆了它」。
script: abolish＝廢除制度。abominate＝強烈厭惡。demolish＝拆毀建築。診所標語：恨≠拆≠廢，三位一體但不是同一個動作。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 廢法鈕: abolish walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「廢法鈕」出場：abolish 一上場梗就黏住——廢除。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 厭惡臉: abominate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「厭惡臉」出場：abominate 一上場梗就黏住——厭惡。

members.senseAnchor: destroy completely; humiliate or depress completely
